notes.title: 🎮ZOMVIRUS Metastore Release Preparation News
notes.notes: [p]Hello, fellow survivors![/p][p]This is the ZOMVIRUS development team.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to your enthusiastic interest and valuable feedback, we're excited to be making final preparations for ZOMVIRUS's official Metastore release.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧Standalone Environment Optimization in Progress[/h3][p]We're currently conducting final checks and optimizations to ensure the game runs reliably in a standalone environment.[/p][p]We're also preparing to allow players to play ZOMVIRUS freely, anytime, anywhere, using only their MetaQuest device, without a PC.[/p][p][/p][p]More players will soon be able to experience the thrilling survival action of ZOMVIRUS through the Metastore.[/p][p]We look forward to seeing what ZOMVIRUS, enjoyable anytime, anywhere, will look like on the Metastore.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚀Major Update in Preparation for Release[/h3][p]With the Metastore launch, we're also working on various improvements to provide a more complete gaming experience.[/p][p]📌Graphics and performance optimization[/p][p]📌Zombie variety diversification and several map structural reorganizations[/p][p]📌Improved control convenience and overall stability[/p][p][/p][p]We are currently developing the overall gameplay environment, focusing particularly on maximizing immersion in the VR environment.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/76525878872cfe4a2711d78f00bdce287253d689.png"][/img][/p][p]🧟‍♂️Survival, but more than that, suspense[/p][p]ZOMVIRUS goes beyond a simple zombie shooter; we aim to convey the true joy of survival through the intuitive controls and immersion unique to VR.[/p][p]Unpredictable threats, survival determined by a single bullet, and intense combat where moment-to-moment decisions can change the course of the game.[/p][p]All of this unfolds in real time at your fingertips.[/p][p][/p][p]Are you ready to unleash your survival instincts?[/p][p]Experience Hongdae, Seoul in person with ZOMVIRUS.[/p][p][/p][p]We look forward to your continued support.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]— The Dream of the ZOMVIRUS Development Team[/p]

notes.title: 🎮ZOMVIRUS Development Notes: Game Optimization Progress Report
notes.notes: [p]Hello, fellow survivors![/p][p]This is the ZOMVIRUS development team.[/p][p][/p][p]In this Developer Note, we'd like to share the in-game optimization work we've been doing over the past few weeks.[/p][p]We've made various improvements to provide a comfortable and immersive VR survival experience.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]✅System Resource Optimization - Improved GPU/CPU Share[/p][p]ZOMVIRUS strives for a strong sense of immersion through realistic lighting, sophisticated zombie animations, and physically-based effects.[/p][p]However, we discovered that some elements were consuming more system resources than necessary and determined that optimizations were necessary.[/p][p][/p][p]This optimization work has resulted in the following improvements.[/p][p]Shader Optimization: We streamlined repeatedly called shader calculations and applied LOD (Level of Detail) to less important objects to improve processing efficiency.[/p][p]Animation: Cached repeated zombie movements and NPC path data to reduce CPU load.[/p][p]Effect Resource Reorganization: Prioritized resource loading for key effects, such as explosions, shooting, and death effects, to improve memory efficiency.[/p][p][/p][p]As a result of these measures, we've seen an average 15-25% reduction in GPU usage at the same graphics quality level.[/p][p]This allows for more stable frames to be maintained, especially in the latter half of waves and during large-scale appearances.[/p][p][/p][p]We're currently continuing optimization work to ensure a smooth return to standard solo mode,[/p][p]and aim to achieve an average of 70-90 fps.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]🧱Object Relocation for VR Environment Optimization[/p][p]Map interior objects have been relocated to ensure visibility and natural movement patterns in the VR environment.[/p][p][/p][p]Key improvements include.[/p][p]Removal of View Obstructions: Reorganized miscellaneous sunny objects located at shoulder-to-chest height from the player's viewpoint, enhancing the sense of openness in VR.[/p][p]Important Object Emphasis: Improved placement of essential elements, such as ammunition and recovery items, so they can be seen at a glance.[/p][p][/p][p]These adjustments are not simply visual rearrangements; they aim to improve the UX in a fundamental way, taking into account the VR player's field of view and movement.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]🔜Future Plans[/p][p]We plan to steadily carry out optimization work and will continue to make continuous improvements.[/p][p]Your feedback is our most powerful tool in guiding the development of ZOMVIRUS.[/p][p]Please continue to share your thoughts and impressions as you play.[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to all users who participated in testing and provided us with their valuable feedback.[/p][p]ZOMVIRUS will evolve together with you.[/p][p][/p][p]Please look forward to future content updates.[/p][p]Be faster, smarter, and more powerful than the zombies, and survive to the end.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: 🔧 [ZOMVIRUS Update News] Standard Gun Control System! 🔧
notes.notes: [p]Hello, fellow survivors.[/p][p]This is the ZOMVIRUS development team.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we're announcing major overhauls to the gun control system, which has been a long-standing topic of user feedback.[/p][p]As this is an element that determines the feel and immersion of combat, we've meticulously reviewed each aspect based on your feedback.[/p][p]We're currently working on a major overhaul to ensure a more immersive and stable combat experience in the VR environment.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]1. Improved Gun Control Sensitivity and Shake[/p][p]One of the most frequently reported issues we've received is feedback like, "My hands shake even when I'm quiet, making it difficult to aim," and "When I add a gun, it becomes too much fun and breaks the immersion."[/p][p][/p][p]Issue:[/p][p]- Previously, unnecessary shaking of the hand and gun even when standing still made aiming difficult and inconvenient.[/p][p][/p][p]Solution:[/p][p]- This revision improves hand position stability, ensuring the gun remains naturally stable even when standing still.[/p][p]- We've reduced unnecessary gun shaking in VR environments, allowing for smoother, more precise firing.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/ccdb56c0f7c353af6a15c47c967c0bf673934cc3.gif"][/img][/p][p]2. Improved Gun Grab System Flexibility[/p][p]We received feedback that the previous system felt unnatural, with players experiencing awkward gripping of the gun, their hands flicking when gripping it with both hands, and inaccurate loading.[/p][p]The following improvements have been made to provide a more natural and flexible control experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Improvements:[/p][p]- The grab points have been completely redesigned to more intuitively grasp various parts of the gun, including the handle, magazine, and slide.[/p][p]- We've reduced the apparent stuttering when firing with both hands, allowing for a smoother grip.[/p][p]- Improved magazine ejection and reloading methods have enhanced the physical response when grabbing and reloading the magazine, providing a more realistic feel for the actual weapon.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/d3a786b9e9181bc8116ca5bf2cfcca5581f7998a.gif"][/img][/p][p]3. Firearm Recoil Renewal[/p][p]We received feedback that the recoil felt too strong or unnatural when firing firearms, resulting in a lackluster shooting experience.[/p][p]In response to this feedback, we have adjusted the recoil values and recoil animations for all weapons to be more realistic.[/p][p][/p][p]Improvements:[/p][p]- We are currently applying recoil that matches the unique characteristics of each weapon, such as pistols and rifles.[/p][p]- We have improved the reaction time and position return speed of the hand recoil after firing, providing a more realistic impact feel.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/f4e11dd95dc948ca2894c6fb5e225388d90cc50d.gif"][/img][/p][p]4. Planned Introduction of Two-Handed Pistol Grab Feature[/p][p]- Currently a feature in internal testing, we plan to officially introduce two-handed pistol grab functionality in the next update.[/p][p]- We are currently in the final testing phase and will be introducing it soon in an update.[/p][p][/p][p]At ZOMVIRUS, your feedback is of the utmost importance to us.[/p][p]We will continue to make steady improvements to further enhance the immersion and realism of gameplay.[/p][p]Please report any bugs or suggest improvements through the official Discord or Steam message boards.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]The Dream of the ZOMVIRUS Development Team[/p]

notes.title: 'ZOMVIRUS ' Official release
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! This is the ZOMVIRUS team.
It’s been a while since we last reached out!

During the Early Access period, we went through various trials and errors, reflecting on feedback and making improvements. After a long journey, we are finally here with exciting news.

Today, we bring you updates regarding the official release of ZOMVIRUS and changes to the game.

① Changes to the Gameplay
Before: The game followed an open-world-like progression.

Players moved through different areas, searching for safe zones and clearing stages upon reaching the destination.
When moving to a new area, zombies and weapons would reset.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/7458dd59b3ad438b36d7804678c4b5c04753aac4.png[/img]

After: The game now follows a stage-based progression.

The Hongdae district has been divided into different zones, where players must clear each stage.
Clearing a stage creates a separate area for players to rest and prepare.
Once a gun is obtained, it can be used continuously.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/6c2e2be69f22a8582eeffec3384e46e22c15eadf.png[/img]

② Strengthening the Game's Narrative
Before: Aside from being set in a Korean zombie apocalypse, the story lacked depth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/8531e74e8a1577780934964387c44e304a3c2d06.png[/img]

After: The tutorial has been revised to enhance the coherence of the storyline.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/028581db9a96099a68020cac22dd68893894dcd5.png[/img]

③ New Areas & Zombies Added
New Area (Hapjeong Station, Line 2): A new zone inside Hapjeong Station has been added for gameplay
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/a7420d266f9f8537040fe5493ffab7cde1066566.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/ef07308b52a066e9b9f9039ff66022fba8871209.png[/img]

New Zombies: The "Tattooed Pig Zombie" and a "Large Zombie" have been introduced.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/4a2394e1dfbf3851f068dab959ea4522ce424c93.png[/img]

④ Renewal of Hongdae Street Background
Some parts of Hongdae Street have been modified.

1) Sidewalk remodeling
Before: Some sidewalks were awkwardly designed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/8a6e518e6daf990976c77a28e4d5d45c3b710efa.png[/img]
After: Sidewalk slopes have been improved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/6c10d51207011632cd00bb909926de01b154a89b.png[/img]

2)Changes to the Hongdae street map structure
Before: The streets felt empty and lacked structures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/1b019c1d7382b44e8e92c442c641eb29bac6073e.png[/img]
After: The environment has been modified to fit the apocalyptic concept.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/6c10d51207011632cd00bb909926de01b154a89b.png[/img]

⑤ Other Changes
Reduced difficulty in obtaining weapons
Reduced difficulty in obtaining consumables
UI improvements
Game optimization updates
Beyond these updates, you can now experience the new and improved ZOMVIRUS in the game!

Our ZOMVIRUS team is always eager to hear from our "Survivors."

If you have any feedback regarding survival challenges, supplies, or shelter, please let us know.

We will continue to strive to create a fun and engaging game experience.

Thank you!

notes.title: Introducing the 'ZOMVIRUS'
notes.notes:
◎ Overview  
*ZOMVIRUS* is a first-person zombie apocalypse survival action game set in Seoul, South Korea. Players start in a quarantined zone filled with zombies and journey toward their designated safe area, encountering various storylines along the way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/38f1176511f76e62d2cc7509552cfc68b9828012.png[/img]

◎ Genre  
*ZOMVIRUS* is a VR-exclusive, PvE-focused zombie apocalypse survival action game. As the lone survivor in a zombie-ravaged Hongdae, players must use available weapons and supplies to escape the quarantined zone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/01f4b8991102591ed4d446b6ac1e13dc22fc15c6.png[/img]

◎ Core Fun  
The core thrill of the game lies in surviving among powerful and fast-paced, algorithm-driven Korean zombies by utilizing weapons and supplies to make it out alive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/9f028e79a5e2eff775b50960ce3df2fbd07fb097.png[/img]

◎ Features  
Unlike other similar games, *ZOMVIRUS* immerses players in the real-world setting of Hongdae, one of Korea’s iconic tourist areas.

- Immersive VR Environment  
  Players experience a heightened sense of realism, as gameplay requires operational precision. Rather than using basic FPS-style controls on PC or mobile, players grip and reload weapons with one or both hands, simulating real handling for enhanced immersion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/1268cb0360e718e65435fc450310777189d2b338.png[/img]

- Variety of Korean-Style Weapons
  Following the global collapse triggered by the zombie outbreak, the Korean government quickly shut down high-risk zones and supplied survivors with firearms for self-defense, allowing them to use weapons like the M1 carbine, M16, as well as Korean-specific rifles like the K2 and K5.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/02162ba063a5a5b66ca7688432f6bde27b05f1b5.png[/img]

- Fast and Powerful Korean Zombies
  Zombie hosts in *ZOMVIRUS* actively seek out new environments for propagation. These zombies rely on sight and sound, with heightened auditory sensitivity. Players can avoid detection by sight, but any loud noise attracts zombies from all directions. Inspired by Korean zombie portrayals in *Kingdom* and *All of Us Are Dead*, *ZOMVIRUS* features fast, strong Korean zombies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/3b41c11391bb9a70610b78858438576b7f923335.png[/img]


◎ Development Progress  
Since the project’s initiation in May 2024, development has expanded to capture an ultra-realistic experience throughout the Hongdae area in Seoul and beyond. With an early access version in the works, developers are incorporating user feedback from various events to enhance the gaming experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/ef322008906dab4a176f77c90fb80e475423289b.png[/img]


◎ Future Plans  
Future updates will include bug fixes, optimizations, new scenarios, maps, and potentially a multiplayer mode. Stay tuned for zombie-quarantined cities like Manhattan and Shanghai. Engage with *ZOMVIRUS* through fan pages and feedback boards—your participation aids in reclaiming zombie-infested cities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/f00e559e67690b32399e27f9f5d3329fab67c2fe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/cc665a892c2cc23ca171d90b7d88419b141fd043.png[/img]
